temeraire.story: A ghostlike veteran warship is pulled toward dismantling by a small black steam tug; the sunset, masts and moon transform historical change into a farewell.

scenes.intent: The pale veteran warship is the authentic opening visual hook
The small dark steam tug reverses the apparent hierarchy of power
The smoke connects the new steam power to the pale masts
The sunset gives the journey poetic meaning
The masts Turner restored despite their removal in the actual tow
A faint moon creates a quiet, contemplative visual pause
The dark river and buoy balance the warm sky
Return to the tug that moves the old giant
The whole painting resolves the historical paradox
